title: Controlled decomposition of shield, rules, heuristic/controller and learned policy on frozen PPO checkpoints (evaluation-only, simulation-only)

persona_generator.type: full factorial: SimulatedCandidate persona type x skill; target = round(10*skill)/2 (authored rule, not tuned per persona)
persona_generator.frozen_stratum: the 5 personas of the frozen study (skills 0.20/0.30/0.60/0.80/0.88; targets 1.0/1.5/3.0/4.0/4.5), reported separately, never part of the primary estimate
persona_generator.training_matched_persona: normal@0.60 (the only persona equal to the single candidate used in the frozen training, see X3-0b N1)

definitions.const_same: always Same (identical to the frozen 'Fixed' policy without shield; verified equal in X3-0c)
definitions.random: uniform over {Easier, Same, Harder}; RandomState((eval_seed*31 + persona_index) mod 2^31-1); the 20 evaluation seeds are the 20 draws
definitions.heuristic: frozen definition: Harder if perf>0.75 and difficulty<5; Easier if perf<0.40 and difficulty>1; else Same
definitions.controller: gap = 5*avg_perf(last 5) - current difficulty; Harder if gap>=0.5; Easier if gap<=-0.5; else Same (documented as exploiting the persona-target rule; an upper REFERENCE, not a fair competitor)
definitions.ppo_zero: PPO receives the all-zero observation at every turn (does PPO use state?)
definitions.ppo_shuffle: PPO receives the observation logged at the same turn of a different persona (partner = persona (i + n//3) mod n, same evaluation seed) from the intact PPO run with the same shield mode and training seed; the environment dynamics remain those of the true persona
definitions.shield_G: canonical guardrails exactly as in the frozen evaluation call (consecutive_failures=0, no infrastructure failure), local copy validated against rl.guardrails
definitions.ablation: shield with one rule (G4, G1, G2, G5 or G6) removed; the remaining rules keep their priority order

primary.endpoint: persona-level tracking MAE difference; per persona: mean over 20 evaluation seeds of session MAE; PPO term = mean over the 5 training seeds
primary.unit: persona (grid, n=40); training seed = second random factor
primary.inference: two-way cluster bootstrap: resample 40 personas and 5 training seeds with replacement, mean of the resampled persona x seed cells; B=10000; numpy default_rng(seed=42); 95% percentile interval
primary.x3b_trigger: run X3-B iff class != Equivalent (Inconclusive, PPO-superior or PPO-adverse), i.e. inconclusive under the equivalence framework or a strong result whose method-level interpretation would need confirmation in a training-consistent environment; never triggered from an individual seed or persona; X3-B additionally requires decision D-N2 (user)

gate_harness.description: G-HARNESS: the new session loop must reproduce the frozen run_session_trajectory exactly on the 5 frozen personas x 5 frozen evaluation seeds for Fixed, Heuristic, PPO raw and PPO+G (5 seeds) and Constant-Same+G; the shield copy must equal the frozen shield on 200000 random states; each mutant (G5 removed; G4 threshold 0.31; heuristic threshold 0.76) must be DETECTED as a mismatch
